Google withheld Dhruv Rathee video in India after court proceedings

Google informed the Delhi High Court that it withheld a YouTube video by content creator Dhruv Rathee in India. This action was taken following proceedings related to remarks made in the video about Hindu deities. The court was informed of Google's compliance with the order to withhold the content within India.
